In mathematics, a '''Butler group''' is a [[Group (mathematics)|group]] that is the [[Image (mathematics)|image]] of a completely decomposable [[abelian group]] of finite [[Rank of an abelian group|rank]]. They were introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Butler|first= M. C. R. |year=1965}}.
